coordinateSystem: Unity native: LEFT-HANDED, +X right, +Y up, +Z forward. Quaternions [x,y,z,w]. Matrices 4x4 column-major (m[col*4+row]). Euler degrees in Unity order (Z, then X, then Y; q = qY*qX*qZ). Convert to three.js in one place, e.g. negate Z of positions and (x,y) of quaternions [ -qx, -qy, qz, qw ] → mirror across XY plane.

semantics.curve: Curve i of an open spline joins knot i -> i+1. P0 = k_i.Position; P1 = k_i.Position + rotate(k_i.Rotation, k_i.TangentOut); P2 = k_{i+1}.Position + rotate(k_{i+1}.Rotation, k_{i+1}.TangentIn); P3 = k_{i+1}.Position (BezierCurve(BezierKnot a, BezierKnot b)). Tangents are knot-local, rotated by the knot rotation. Serialized tangents are used as-is (AutoSmooth is only re-applied when a knot is edited). Cubic Bernstein: P(t) = P0(1-t)^3 + 3P1 t(1-t)^2 + 3P2 t^2(1-t) + P3 t^3; tangent = dP/dt (NOT normalised).
semantics.curveLength: Per curve: polyline through 30 samples at t = i/29 (LUT {distance, t}). Spline length = sum of curve lengths. SplineAnimate uses the LOCAL (container-space) length; SplineContainer.CalculateLength() (used by the return flight) uses the WORLD length (knots transformed first). Identical here (lossy scale 1).
semantics.splineT: SplineUtility.SplineToCurveT(t): t is normalised by ARC LENGTH over the whole spline, not by curve count. d = clamp01(t) * length; walk curves until d <= start + curveLength; curveT = LUT lookup: find first LUT entry with distance > (d - start), lerp t between it and the previous entry. If no curve matched, curveT = 1 on the last curve.
semantics.containerTransform: SplineContainer.EvaluatePosition = transform.TransformPoint(local); EvaluateTangent = transform.TransformVector(local); EvaluateUpVector = transform.TransformDirection(local) (rotation only). With non-uniform lossy scale Unity instead evaluates a NativeSpline baked in world space (not the case here).
semantics.upVector: Spline.GetCurveUpVector(curve, t): per curve a cache of 30 up vectors at t = i/29 computed by CurveUtility.EvaluateUpVector(curve, i/29, startUp = rotate(k_i.Rotation, Y), endUp = rotate(k_{i+1}.Rotation, Y)); result = Vector3.Lerp (NOT normalised, not slerp) between cache[i] and cache[i+1]. EvaluateUpVector builds 16 rotation-minimising frames (double reflection, Wang et al.) along the curve starting from frame {tangent = P1-P0, normal = startUp, binormal = normalize(cross(tangent, normal))}, then distributes the twist between the last RMF normal and endUp linearly in t: angle = acos(dot(lastNormal, endUp)), sign chosen so rotating endUp by it about the last tangent lands on lastNormal; normal_i rotated by AxisAngle(normalize(tangent(t_i)), -lerp(0, angle, t_i)); answer = Slerp between the two bracketing adjusted normals (normal[0] stays startUp). Zero-length tangents are replaced by (P3-P0)/3 first. If tangent || startUp the up is (0,0,0).
semantics.splineAnimate: CardView.DealAlongSpline: SplineAnimate { Method.Speed, MaxSpeed = dealSpeed, Easing = EaseInOut, Alignment = SplineElement, Loop = Once, ObjectForwardAxis = Z, ObjectUpAxis = Y (defaults) }. Path = SplinePath over ALL container splines (1 here). duration = 2 * lengthLocal / MaxSpeed for any easing (lengthLocal / MaxSpeed with EasingMode.None). Each frame: elapsed += dt; u = min(elapsed, duration) / duration; u = EaseInOutQuadratic(u) = (u <= 0.5 ? 2u^2 : 4u - 2u^2 - 1) [EaseIn = u^2, EaseOut = u(2-u)]; position = EvaluatePosition(path, u) (u is the arc-length normalised spline t). Completed fires once u >= 1. Restart(false) first snaps to u = 0.
semantics.splineElementRotation: forward = EvaluateTangent(u) (world); if |forward| <= epsilon use tangent at u+0.01 (or u-0.01 at the end); forward normalised; up = EvaluateUpVector(u) (world); rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(forward, up) * Inverse(LookRotation(Z, Y)) = LookRotation(forward, up). LookRotation: f = normalize(forward); r = normalize(cross(up, f)); u = cross(f, r); basis columns (r, u, f). The card ROOT transform gets this rotation (the card model children keep their own local transforms).
semantics.afterDeal: On Completed: CardView.Flip(revealAtEnd) = DOLocalRotateQuaternion(settle, 0.25s) with NO explicit ease -> DOTween default ease from Assets/Resources/DOTweenSettings.asset: defaultEaseType 6 = Ease.OutQuad. settle = Quaternion.Euler(faceUp ? faceUpLocalEuler : faceDownLocalEuler) with its Y replaced by atan2(forward.x, forward.z) of the landed card (heading kept; only tilt/roll corrected). The card is parented under PokerController/DealtCards (identity-ish parent), so local ~ world.
semantics.returnFlight: CardView.ReturnAlongSpline: SplineAnimate disabled; DOTween.Sequence: Flip(false) [0.25s, OutQuad] then DOVirtual.Float(1 -> 0, lengthWorld / dealSpeed, Ease.InOutQuad) setting position = spline.EvaluatePosition(t) and, if |tangent|^2 > 1e-4, rotation = LookRotation(EvaluateTangent(t), EvaluateUpVector(t)) (first spline of the container, same arc-length t mapping). Note the tangent still points deck->seat, so the card flies BACKWARDS (tail first) on the return. Sequence default ease is Linear. Cards leave in reverse deal order, delay = order * holeStagger * 0.5.
semantics.dealOrder: SplineCardDealer.DealHoleCards: card0 along holeCardSpline0 with delay 0, card1 along holeCardSpline1 with delay holeStagger (DOVirtual.DelayedCall). The card spawns at EvaluatePosition(0) face-down (Show(card,false)) until its deal starts.

codeDefaults.note: serialized values above override these C# field initialisers

derivedTimings.dealFlightSeconds: SplineAnimate Method.Speed + EaseInOut: duration = 2 * lengthLocal / dealSpeed (see each spline)
derivedTimings.returnFlightSeconds: CardView.ReturnAlongSpline: 0.25s Flip(false) THEN lengthWorld / dealSpeed with Ease.InOutQuad
derivedTimings.returnStagger: order * holeStagger * 0.5 (last dealt card leaves first)

dealer.shakerListenersNote: MMF_*Shake feedbacks with no TargetShaker broadcast on their Channel; every enabled listener below on the same channel reacts. The Card_Modular prefab also carries MMPositionShaker + MMRotationShaker (see card.rootComponents), so each dealt hole card rattles.

library.mapping: entries[Card.Index], Card.Index = suit*13 + (rank-2); suit Clubs=0 Diamonds=1 Hearts=2 Spades=3; rank Two=2..Ace=14. CardView sets MeshFilter.sharedMesh = entry.Mesh and sharedMaterials = [library.back (slot 0), entry.Face (slot 1), library.edge (slot 2)]; folded seats use library.folded on all 3 slots. A theme may swap the back texture at runtime (CardLibrary.ApplyBackTexture).

meshSpaceBounds.note: Unity mesh space = FBX vertices * fileScale * globalScale, X negated (Unity right->left-handed import)

size.note: card-root space at identity root rotation (= faceDownLocalEuler 0,0,0): X = width, Y = thickness, Z = length. The root scale is applied in worldSizeAtRootScale.

table.note: The visible felt is the world-space UI canvas Background/Table_Canvas -> Image (see tableCanvas; ThemeManager.ApplyTableFelt swaps its sprite per theme). objects[] = every MeshRenderer/SpriteRenderer outside the HUD canvases and community slots; check activeInHierarchy — the "Table" plane (and Table_Shadow) are INACTIVE in Test.unity, Background_Image (backdrop plane far below) and Card_hole (sprite) are active. ThemeManager also re-textures Background_Image and Table by name at runtime.

environment.renderPipeline: Built-in (Standard shader + Post Processing Stack v2)
